name: noisy-studio-companion
description: The Noisy Studio companion widget, always on top

scripts.dist: npm run check:deps && npm run build:icons && npm run build:ui && npm run build:daemon && electron-builder --mac --dir
scripts.dmg: npm run check:deps && npm run build:icons && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:daemon: cd .. && uv sync --extra local && uv pip install --quiet --no-config pyinstaller && .venv/bin/pyinstaller desktop/daemon.spec --distpath desktop/build/daemon --noconfirm --clean --log-level WARN
scripts.dist:dev: npm run check:deps && npm run build:icons && electron-builder --mac --dir -c.extraMetadata.noisyMode=local -c.productName="Noisy Studio Dev" -c.appId=pl.noisy.studio.companion.dev -c.directories.output=dist-dev -c.mac.icon=build/icon-dev.icns
scripts.check:deps: npm ls --omit=dev >/dev/null || (echo 'desktop: packages missing - run npm ci' && exit 1)

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Noisy Studio listens to you so your coding agents can hear you.
